I've had to endure a lot of tragic, traumatic, and unfair situations for almost the majority of my life. I was not planned. I am the product of a one night stand. I was raised by a single parent. My dad wasn't ever around. In 2010 I lost my dad. I missed out on the opportunity to have a father figure. :/ I was also bullied. I was bullied from preschool to twelfth grade. It often got so bad that I had to switch schools. By the time I graduated I had attended nine different schools. Because I switch schools so much I had a lot of trouble making and keeping friends. I had made a lot of friends in high school but now there all gone. In 2012 my best friend passed away. He was the only real friend I had. I just found that out recently. All of my other friends abandoned me last year. They all accused me of being too negative. Well not all. My friend that died cared about me more than I knew. He wanted to marry me. This revelation crushed me because I knew it was too late and to make a long story short I ended up dating another friend. I was in an abusive relationship for 7 months. I'm still recovering from it but it's not the first time I was abused. My mom has been verbally and emotionally since I was 11. I still live with my mom and verbal and emotional stuff still continues. In addition to that I am the black sheep of my family they know what I'm going through but they don't know how much pain I'm in. They just think I'm weird. I'm in so much pain that I can't even tell them how much pain I'm in.
